# Asolaria — Rust 1.81 ternary Proxima constellation

**Draft four-seat scientific integration, 2026-10-15.** The native executable code and offline HTML viewer are intentionally separate from previous Python/Node baselines and from any unverified raw telescope/photon sources.

## Execute (no external Rust dependencies)

```bash
cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline --release -- out
python independent_referee.py out
```

Open `web/index.html` locally (HTTP-0: no app server), then select `out/EPOCHS-RUST181.csv` to inspect all 200 exact epochs. The `ASOLARIA-PROXIMA-RUST181.hbp` source/observation report and `RUNTIME.hbp` are separate: only actual hosted CPU wall-clock is described by RUNTIME, while huge logical epochs are exact mathematical shortcuts.

Each layer includes independent adversarial checks and a persisted NOTE. The HRM is a two-rate signed-trit summarizer, the GNN a deterministic ternary ring-neighbor aggregate, MTP1/2/3 three **new integer orbital lookahead proxies** (+1,+3,+9 model-years), and Bobby Fischer an explicit independent corrupted-witness/reordered-address rejection. These are architecture-compatible mathematical substitutes, **not byte-identical ports of the originally trained HRM/GNN/LLM/MTP weights**, which were not available from the inspected source pins. The source calls MTP **multi-token prediction**; a separate multi-touch predictor is not implicitly asserted.

## Exact astronomy and long-horizon boundary

- Proxima Centauri star + confirmed planets b and d form **three metadata bodies**, not a confirmed spatial pixel map. Planet c excluded as candidate.
- Approximate NASA-sourced orbital periods: b 11.18465 days, d 5.12338 days, stored as scaled positive integers. One modeled year is 365.25 days. Predictions are **toy circular phase proxies**, not physically credible exoplanet forecasts billions of years from now.
- ESO 11086 × 11256 image metadata implies 124,784,016 image sample locations; **no raw pixels loaded** and no seven calibrated optical wavelength bands available from this run. The viewer clearly distinguishes schematics from photographs.
- 200 explicit epochs `3^1` through `3^200` are represented exactly as integer decimal strings; `3^(10^200)` is evaluated **only modulo** the small orbital denominators via exact decimal-exponent arithmetic. No astronomical physical time is claimed to have elapsed.
- The nilpotent GF(3) 81-trit laws `[0,1,3]` and `[0,4,7]` undergo independent 81-basis checks; their complete loss of original state is not equated to zero *observation* of an expanded reversible hidden-phase system.

## Four-seat scientific gate

Four hosted Rust1.81 CI builds (Ubuntu/Windows × debug/release), all-target Clippy warnings as errors, standard-library unit tests, an **independently implemented integer-only Python** referee checking all 200 orbital ratios, 7 levels, E200 modular arithmetic, actual three corruption attacks, deterministic HBP/CSV byte parity, SHA-256 of produced artifact bytes. Do not infer a trusted instrument source or distinct underlying chassis from cloud runner counts.

HTTP-0 costs zero application-server rental; it does not imply zero CPU, electrical, bandwidth or hardware cost. Past operator-reported physical optical experiments are preserved as historical reports, **not re-run or reclassified** by this software task. No trained living neural substrate, quantum advantage, consciousness or spectral photon memory is established here.

**Do not merge or release without review.**
